fields.discharge_instructions: Complete the full course of oral antibiotics. Check blood glucose twice daily and keep a written record. Take blood pressure medication as before. Return to the emergency department immediately if fever above 38.5 C, shortness of breath or chest pain recurs.

hard_cases: Clean baseline: primary + 2 secondary diagnoses and 2 procedures.
Two pages: discharge instructions and the physician sign-off are on page 2.
